canonical_data: Append-only JSONL event log per repository with distilled Markdown summaries, project map, and plan files; structure cache stays uncommitted
strengths: Append-only typed event log with distilled summaries the agent reads at session start
Pre-commit judgment gate warns before repeating recorded failures, beyond plain storage
One MCP server serves every project with registry routing and no cloud or telemetry
Published dogfooding study and comparison table with stated snapshot caveats
weaknesses: Token-saving and ROI figures are author-measured without independent replication
Python-only implementation with a single-maintainer project
README tool counts disagree across sections, suggesting fast-moving docs
Watcher daemon and git hooks add per-project moving parts to operate
why_it_matters: The only coding-agent memory that pairs an event-sourced project log with an enforceable pre-commit judgment gate, so agents inherit experience instead of repeating yesterday's bug.
